guideContent.strategyOverview:
Jeskai superfriends built around a unique angle: Humility. All creatures become 1/1 vanilla bodies with no abilities, but planeswalkers are unaffected — making them virtually immune to combat damage. This is "The Silent Court": a board state where 1/1 creatures can barely scratch your planeswalkers' loyalty, while your walkers accumulate value unopposed.

The deck operates in two modes. Mode A (Humility online): creatures are blanked, planeswalkers are safe. Win via Chandra burn (Legacy of Fire end-step damage + Guff's -3 scaling with planeswalker count), irremovable emblems from Awakened Inferno, or token armies from Elspeth. The stax shell — Humility, High Noon, Stasis, Teferi Time Raveler, Narset — locks opponents out of instant-speed interaction while Sphere of Safety and Norn's Annex make attacking prohibitively expensive. Mode B (no Humility): creatures protect your planeswalkers. Deepglow Skate doubles loyalty. Sarkhan's +1 turns all walkers into 4/4 flying Dragons for an alpha strike.

WARNING: Never activate Sarkhan's +1 with Humility in play. Planeswalkers that become creatures lose all abilities under Humility and become 1/1 blanks.

Combo potential is high: The Chain Veil + Teferi Temporal Archmage generates infinite mana, draw, and planeswalker activations. Teferi Master of Time + Ichormoon Gauntlet enables infinite extra turns. Stasis + Smothering Tithe creates a hard lock where nobody untaps but you sustain via Treasure tokens. Teferi's Puzzle Box + Narset strips opponents' hands every turn.

Commodore Guff ties it together: +1 creates Wizard tokens that tap for red mana (specifically for planeswalker spells), 0 draws cards for all players (fueling Smothering Tithe and Rhystic Study), and -3 deals X damage and draws X cards where X is your planeswalker count.

deckCategories.name: Burn Win-Cons
deckCategories.description: Chandra planeswalkers that scale damage with planeswalker count. Legacy of Fire's end-step trigger and Guff's -3 together deal 2X damage per opponent per cycle.

deckCategories.name: Token Generators
deckCategories.description: Planeswalkers that create creature tokens for board presence and alternative win conditions. Storm Slayer doubles ALL tokens including Treasures.

deckCategories.name: Stax & Lockdown
deckCategories.description: Enchantments and planeswalkers that restrict opponents while leaving your planeswalkers unaffected. Humility blanks creatures, High Noon stops instant-speed plays, Stasis prevents untapping.

deckCategories.name: Planeswalker Support
deckCategories.description: Cards that multiply planeswalker activations, add loyalty counters, or copy planeswalkers. The Chain Veil is the combo engine.

deckCategories.name: Value Engines
deckCategories.description: Planeswalkers and enchantments that generate card advantage, mana, or selection. Teferi Temporal Archmage untaps permanents including The Chain Veil.

deckCategories.name: Planeswalker Defense
deckCategories.description: Cards that protect planeswalkers from removal, combat, or board wipes. The Wanderer prevents noncombat damage to you.

deckCategories.name: Board Control
deckCategories.description: Sweepers and mass removal. Under Humility, power-based wipes like Dusk // Dawn and Elspeth's -3 clear the board while leaving planeswalkers untouched.

deckCategories.name: Interaction
deckCategories.description: Targeted removal, counterspells, and tutors. Enlightened Tutor finds Humility, Chain Veil, Stasis, or Smothering Tithe at instant speed.

deckCategories.name: Ramp
deckCategories.description: Mana acceleration to deploy planeswalkers ahead of curve. Chrome Mox and Mox Amber provide explosive starts. Smothering Tithe generates Treasures passively.

winConditions.title: Chandra Burn Engine
winConditions.description: Chandra Legacy of Fire's end-step trigger deals X damage to each opponent where X is the number of planeswalkers you control. Guff's -3 draws X cards and deals X damage. With 4-5 planeswalkers in play, this deals 8-10 damage per opponent per turn cycle. Both abilities scale together as you deploy more walkers.

sources.detail: Primary burn win condition via planeswalker count scaling

winConditions.title: Emblem Inevitability
winConditions.description: Chandra Awakened Inferno's +2 gives each opponent a permanent emblem that deals 1 damage at the beginning of their upkeep. Emblems cannot be removed by any game mechanic. After 3-4 activations, each opponent takes 3-4 damage per upkeep — a game-ending clock that no amount of interaction can stop.

winConditions.title: Token Overrun
winConditions.description: Elspeth Storm Slayer's static ability doubles all token creation. Elspeth Sun's Champion makes 3 Soldiers per turn (doubled to 6). Ajani creates Kithkin tokens. The Eternal Wanderer creates 2/2 Samurai with double strike. Under Humility these tokens are 1/1, but without it they overwhelm the board.

winConditions.title: Sarkhan Alpha Strike
winConditions.description: Sarkhan's +1 turns all planeswalkers you control into 4/4 Dragon creatures with flying until end of turn. With 5+ planeswalkers, this is 20+ flying damage in a single combat step. Mode B only — do NOT activate with Humility in play, as planeswalkers that become creatures lose all abilities and become 1/1 blanks.

sources.name: The Commander Tavern — Commodore Guff Superfriends

winConditions.title: Chain Veil Infinite
winConditions.description: Teferi Temporal Archmage's -1 untaps 4 permanents (Chain Veil + 3 mana sources). Activate Chain Veil again for another PW activation. With enough mana rocks, this generates infinite mana, infinite card draw, and infinite planeswalker activations. Draw entire deck and burn opponents to death with any Chandra.

winConditions.title: Infinite Turns
winConditions.description: Teferi Master of Time activates on every player's turn (not just yours). Ichormoon Gauntlet gives every planeswalker [0]: Proliferate and [-12]: Take an extra turn. Proliferate via the Gauntlet-granted ability to accumulate loyalty on all planeswalkers. With enough walkers proliferating, reach -12 on Gauntlet for infinite extra turns.

synergies.title: The Silent Court
synergies.description: All creatures become 1/1 with no abilities. Planeswalkers are unaffected. 1/1 creatures deal minimal damage to planeswalker loyalty, making your walkers virtually immune to combat damage. The defining interaction of the deck.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Core deck identity — Humility + planeswalkers interaction

synergies.title: Storm Slayer + Smothering Tithe
synergies.description: Elspeth Storm Slayer's static ability doubles ALL token creation, including Treasure tokens from Smothering Tithe. Each opponent's draw step creates 2 Treasures instead of 1 (if they don't pay). Massive mana acceleration that funds planeswalker deployment.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Token doubling applies to artifact tokens

synergies.title: Stasis + Smothering Tithe
synergies.description: Stasis prevents all players from untapping. You sustain the lock via Treasure tokens from Smothering Tithe — opponents can't pay the {2} tax with tapped lands. Planeswalker abilities don't require untapping, so your walkers continue operating normally under the lock.

synergies.title: Puzzle Box + Narset
synergies.description: Each opponent puts their hand on the bottom of their library, then draws that many cards. Narset restricts opponents to 1 draw per turn. Net result: opponents lose their entire hand and draw 1 card each turn. Soft lock that forces opponents to play off the top.

synergies.title: Teferi MoT + Stasis
synergies.description: Teferi's -3 phases out a creature. Under Stasis, untap steps are skipped, so phased-out creatures never phase back in — permanent removal as long as Stasis remains active.

synergies.title: Sphere of Safety + Enchantment Density
synergies.description: With 8 enchantments in the deck, Sphere of Safety requires opponents to pay 8 mana per creature to attack you or your planeswalkers. Combined with Humility (1/1 creatures) and Norn's Annex (pay 2 life or {W} per attacker), attacking becomes prohibitively expensive.

synergies.title: Chandra Legacy + Guff Double Burn
synergies.description: Both abilities scale with planeswalker count. Chandra Legacy deals X damage at end step. Guff's -3 deals X damage and draws X cards. Combined, they deal 2X damage per opponent per turn cycle where X is your planeswalker count.

synergies.title: Ajani Steadfast Loyalty Distribution
synergies.description: Ajani's -2 puts a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control. Functions as a planeswalker-specific proliferate, accelerating all walkers toward their ultimates simultaneously. With 5+ planeswalkers, this is more efficient than standard proliferate.

highlights.name: Humility
highlights.reason: The deck's defining card. All creatures become 1/1 with no abilities, making planeswalkers virtually immune to combat damage. This unique angle separates this build from all other superfriends decks. Enables the entire stax shell.

highlights.name: Chandra, Legacy of Fire
highlights.reason: The primary burn win condition. End-step trigger deals X damage to each opponent where X is planeswalkers you control. +1 generates red mana equal to planeswalker count. Scales exponentially as you deploy more walkers.

highlights.name: The Chain Veil
highlights.reason: The combo engine. Extra planeswalker activation each turn. Combos with Teferi Temporal Archmage for infinite mana, draw, and activations. Also strong as fair value — double-activating any planeswalker is powerful.

highlights.name: Ichormoon Gauntlet
highlights.reason: Gives every planeswalker [0]: Proliferate and [-12]: Take an extra turn. Also adds loyalty counters on noncreature spell casts. Enables infinite turn combos with Teferi Master of Time.

sources.name: Grazzet — Planeswalker Party Precon Upgrade Guide

highlights.name: Stasis
highlights.reason: Hard lock piece with Smothering Tithe. All players skip untap steps while you sustain via Treasure tokens. Planeswalker abilities don't require untapping. Teferi Who Slows the Sunset provides backup upkeep payment.

highlights.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
highlights.reason: Token doubler on a planeswalker. Doubles ALL tokens including Treasures from Smothering Tithe. Also provides tokens and mana-value-based removal that functions under Humility (checks MV, not power/toughness).

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Token doubling on a planeswalker body

highlights.name: Teferi, Master of Time
highlights.reason: Activates on any player's turn, not just yours. Enables 5 different infinite-turn combo lines with existing deck cards. Provides card selection and phasing-based removal that synergizes with Stasis.

highlights.name: Sphere of Safety
highlights.reason: Unlike Ghostly Prison (which only protects you), Sphere of Safety explicitly protects you AND your planeswalkers. With 8 enchantments, opponents must pay 8 mana per attacking creature. Combined with Humility and Norn's Annex, attacking is prohibitive.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Protects planeswalkers specifically, not just player

highlights.name: Enlightened Tutor
highlights.reason: Finds Humility, The Chain Veil, Stasis, Smothering Tithe, or Sphere of Safety at instant speed. The stax toolbox enabler that fetches whichever lock piece the situation demands.

sources.name: The Commander Tavern — Commodore Guff Superfriends

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Ramp engine that becomes a combo piece with Stasis. Tokens doubled by Elspeth Storm Slayer. Fueled by Guff's 0 ability (each opponent draws, triggering Tithe). The mana backbone of the deck.
